title: Gold Nanoparticles Enhance the Antibacterial and Osteogenic Properties of Polyetheretherketone
html:
Journal of Dental Research, Ahead of Print.
Polyetheretherketone (PEEK) is a promising implant material due to its excellent physicochemical properties and bonelike mechanical strength. However, its inherent lack of antibacterial and osteogenic activities limits broader clinical application. In ...
